immune.usageZh: 形容词“免疫的”。immune to a disease；immune system。名词 immunity。不要写成 imun。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands so you stay immune to school colds.
examples.trans: 洗手，好对学校感冒保持免疫。

examples.sentence: Sleep keeps her immune system less grumpy in PE.
examples.trans: 睡眠让她的免疫系统在体育课上没那么脾气差。

examples.sentence: A smoothie labelled 'immune' cannot replace soap.
examples.trans: 标着“免疫”的奶昔代替不了肥皂。

examples.sentence: Night-shift nurses are not immune to skipped meals sold as dedication.
examples.trans: 夜班护士并不能免疫于被卖成敬业的漏餐。

examples.sentence: Marketing that calls a vitamin an immune system has confused a label with a liver.
examples.trans: 把维生素叫做免疫系统的营销，把标签和肝脏搞混了。

examples.sentence: No population is immune to guidelines that photograph soap and never fund sinks.
examples.trans: 没有哪个群体能免疫于只拍肥皂、从不资助水槽的准则。

disease.usageZh: 可数名词“疾病”。prevent/fight/cure a disease；infectious disease。形容词 diseased。

examples.sentence: Flu is a common winter disease at our school.
examples.trans: 流感是我们学校冬天的常见病。

examples.sentence: She stayed home so the disease would not spread in class.
examples.trans: 她待在家，好让病不在班里传。

examples.sentence: Processed snacks do not cause every disease, but they do not fight any.
examples.trans: 加工零食不会导致每一种病，但也打不赢任何一种。

examples.sentence: The poster named five diseases and zero paper-towel budgets.
examples.trans: 海报点了五种病，零个擦手纸预算。

examples.sentence: Calling burnout a personal disease hides the rota that produced it.
examples.trans: 把过劳叫做个人疾病，藏起了制造过劳的排班。

examples.sentence: A public that funds slogans faster than clinics will keep renaming disease as lifestyle.
examples.trans: 口号比诊所筹得快的公众，会继续把疾病改名为生活方式。

guidelines.usageZh: 名词（常复数）“准则；指导方针”。follow/issue guidelines。guideline 单数较少。

examples.sentence: Our PE teacher posted guidelines for warming up.
examples.trans: 体育老师贴了热身准则。

examples.sentence: Follow the canteen guidelines: wash before you queue.
examples.trans: 遵守食堂准则：排队前先洗手。

examples.sentence: The flu guidelines asked for soap; the dispenser was a photograph.
examples.trans: 流感准则要求肥皂；皂液器是一张照片。

examples.sentence: Lab guidelines name gloves; they should also name who restocks them.
examples.trans: 实验室准则点名手套；也应点名谁补货。

examples.sentence: Guidelines that never mention sleep still mention extra classes.
examples.trans: 从不提睡眠的准则，仍会提加课。

examples.sentence: A guideline that cannot name a sink is a brochure wearing a lab coat.
examples.trans: 点不出水槽的准则，是穿着白大褂的手册。

maintain.usageZh: 及物动词“维持；保养”。maintain health/a habit；名词 maintenance。

examples.sentence: Drink water to maintain your energy in PE.
examples.trans: 体育课喝水，好维持体力。

examples.sentence: He maintains a sleep time even during exam week.
examples.trans: 即使考试周他也维持睡眠时间。

examples.sentence: You cannot maintain muscles on snacks and slogans.
examples.trans: 靠零食和口号维持不了肌肉。

examples.sentence: The clinic maintains hours; the poster maintains a smile.
examples.trans: 诊所维持开放时间；海报维持微笑。

examples.sentence: To maintain 'wellness' while cutting night staff is to maintain a brand.
examples.trans: 一边裁夜班一边维持“健康”，是在维持品牌。

examples.sentence: What a city maintains in soap and rest is what it actually believes about bodies.
examples.trans: 一座城市在肥皂和休息上维持什么，才是它真正相信身体的什么。

balanced.usageZh: 形容词“均衡的”。a balanced diet/life。动词 balance，名词 balance。

examples.sentence: A balanced lunch has rice, vegetables and some meat.
examples.trans: 均衡的午餐有米饭、蔬菜和一点肉。

examples.sentence: She wants a balanced week: homework and a walk.
examples.trans: 她想要均衡的一周：作业和散步。

examples.sentence: A 'balanced' snack bar still listed sugar first.
examples.trans: 所谓均衡的零食棒，配料表上糖仍排第一。

examples.sentence: A balanced rota would let the canteen cook sit down.
examples.trans: 均衡的排班会让食堂厨师坐下来。

examples.sentence: Balanced copy that never balances sleep against extra classes is advertising.
examples.trans: 从不把睡眠和加课放上秤的均衡文案，是广告。

examples.sentence: A diet called balanced while fruit is locked after 8 p.m. has balanced a till, not a plate.
examples.trans: 晚上八点后水果上锁却仍称均衡的饮食，平衡的是收银台，不是盘子。

processed.usageZh: 形容词“加工过的”。processed food(s)。动词 process，名词 processing。

examples.sentence: Mum limits processed snacks on weekdays.
examples.trans: 妈妈工作日限制加工零食。

examples.sentence: The canteen still sells processed sausages beside the fruit.
examples.trans: 食堂在水果旁边仍卖加工香肠。

examples.sentence: Processed foods travel farther than the cook who could have used an egg.
examples.trans: 加工食品走得比那个本可以用一只蛋的厨师更远。

examples.sentence: A lab that studies processed sugar should also study who packs it at 3 a.m.
examples.trans: 研究加工糖的实验室，也应研究谁在凌晨三点打包。

examples.sentence: Calling a processed bar 'fuel' does not make it a meal.
examples.trans: 把加工棒叫做“燃料”，并不能让它变成一餐。

examples.sentence: A food system processed for shelf life has processed the eater into a customer of emergency snacks.
examples.trans: 为保质期而加工的食物系统，把进食者加工成了应急零食的顾客。

regular.usageZh: 形容词“规律的；定期的”。regular exercise/check-up。副词 regularly。

examples.sentence: I take regular walks after dinner.
examples.trans: 我晚饭后规律散步。

examples.sentence: Regular PE is not the same as one Sports Day photo.
examples.trans: 规律的体育课，不等于一次运动会照片。

examples.sentence: Without regular sleep, her mood became a weather report.
examples.trans: 没有规律睡眠，她的心情变成天气预报。

examples.sentence: Regular handwashing needs regular soap, not a laminated poster.
examples.trans: 规律洗手需要规律的肥皂，不是塑封海报。

examples.sentence: A regular workout that never restocks the water fountain is a performance.
examples.trans: 从不给饮水机补水的规律训练，是表演。

examples.sentence: Regularity sold as virtue while night clinics close is a timetable, not care.
examples.trans: 夜诊关闭时仍把规律卖成美德，那是时刻表，不是照料。

physical.usageZh: 形容词“身体的”。physical activity/health/education。名词 physics 不同义。

examples.sentence: Physical education is my favourite class.
examples.trans: 体育是我最喜欢的课。

examples.sentence: We need physical activity, not only sitting tests.
examples.trans: 我们需要身体活动，不只是坐着考试。

examples.sentence: Physical tiredness after a workout is different from exam-week fog.
examples.trans: 训练后的身体累，和考试周的雾不是一回事。

examples.sentence: Physical labour in the canteen is also health work.
examples.trans: 食堂里的体力劳动也是健康工作。

examples.sentence: A physical that never asks about sleep has examined a costume.
examples.trans: 从不问睡眠的体检，检查的是戏服。

examples.sentence: Physical health copy that erases the cleaner of the gym has already chosen which bodies count.
examples.trans: 抹掉健身房清洁工的身体健康文案，已经选好了哪些身体算数。

muscles.usageZh: 名词 muscle 的复数，“肌肉”。build/strengthen muscles。形容词 muscular。

examples.sentence: My leg muscles hurt after the long run.
examples.trans: 长跑后我的腿部肌肉疼。

examples.sentence: Protein and rest both feed muscles; posters feed cameras.
examples.trans: 蛋白质和休息都喂肌肉；海报喂摄像头。

examples.sentence: You cannot grow muscles if you skip sleep to 'work harder'.
examples.trans: 为了“更努力”而熬夜，长不出肌肉。

examples.sentence: The gym named muscles and forgot the joints of the night cleaner.
examples.trans: 健身房点名了肌肉，忘了夜班清洁工的关节。

examples.sentence: Sore muscles after honesty are cheaper than sore moods after a slogan.
examples.trans: 诚实之后酸的肌肉，比口号之后酸的心情便宜。

examples.sentence: A culture that photographs muscles and never wages will keep calling exhaustion discipline.
examples.trans: 只拍肌肉从不拍工资的文化，会继续把精疲力尽叫做纪律。

mood.usageZh: 可数名词“心情；情绪”。in a good/bad mood；improve one's mood。

examples.sentence: A short walk puts me in a better mood.
examples.trans: 走一小段路让我心情更好。

examples.sentence: Lack of water ruins his mood before maths.
examples.trans: 缺水会在数学课前毁掉他的心情。

examples.sentence: Her mood recovered after nine hours, not after a slogan.
examples.trans: 她的心情是在九小时睡眠后恢复的，不是一句口号之后。

examples.sentence: Staff mood is data; the canteen survey forgot to ask.
examples.trans: 员工心情是数据；食堂调查忘了问。

examples.sentence: A mood app cannot replace a window that opens.
examples.trans: 心情应用代替不了一扇能打开的窗。

examples.sentence: Policy that treats mood as a private failure has outsourced rest to willpower.
examples.trans: 把心情当成私人失败的政策，是把休息外包给了意志力。

workout.usageZh: 可数名词“一次锻炼”。do/have a workout。动词 work out。

examples.sentence: I have a short workout before breakfast.
examples.trans: 早饭前我有一小段训练。

examples.sentence: Check with the nurse before a hard workout.
examples.trans: 高强度训练前先问护士。

examples.sentence: A workout that ignores water is a dare, not a plan.
examples.trans: 无视水的训练是打赌，不是计划。

examples.sentence: The school's 'optional workout' sat in the same hour as unpaid tutoring.
examples.trans: 学校的“可选训练”和义务补习撞在同一小时。

examples.sentence: Gyms sell workouts; joints keep the receipt.
examples.trans: 健身房卖训练课；关节留着收据。

examples.sentence: A city that funds a workout mural and not a clinic has chosen a pose.
examples.trans: 给训练壁画拨款、不给诊所拨款的城市，选择的是姿势。

individual.usageZh: 名词“个人”；形容词“个别的”。individual needs；each individual。副词 individually。

examples.sentence: Each individual in our class brought a water bottle.
examples.trans: 班里每个人都带了水瓶。

examples.sentence: The nurse asked about individual sleep hours, not only averages.
examples.trans: 护士问的是个人睡眠时数，不只是平均数。

examples.sentence: Individual choice cannot wash a whole canteen's knives.
examples.trans: 个人选择洗不了整个食堂的刀。

examples.sentence: An individual exemption from PE still needs a place to sit that is not a corridor.
examples.trans: 个人免修体育，仍需要一个不是走廊的座位。

examples.sentence: Calling pollution an individual habit is a very cheap guideline.
examples.trans: 把污染叫做个人习惯，是非常便宜的准则。

examples.sentence: Public health that stops at the individual has already decided not to fund the tap.
examples.trans: 停在个人身上的公共卫生，已经决定不给水龙头拨款。

role.usageZh: 可数名词“作用；角色”。play a role in；the role of sleep。

examples.sentence: Sleep plays a big role in my morning mood.
examples.trans: 睡眠在我早上的心情里起很大作用。

examples.sentence: Water plays a role in every PE lesson, not only in posters.
examples.trans: 水在每节体育课里起作用，不只在海报里。

examples.sentence: Soap's role is boring and therefore easy to cut from a budget.
examples.trans: 肥皂的作用很无聊，因此容易从预算里砍掉。

examples.sentence: Canteen cooks play a role in immunity that no vitamin ad will name.
examples.trans: 食堂厨师在免疫里起的作用，维生素广告不会点名。

examples.sentence: The role of 'wellness ambassador' paid less than the night cleaner.
examples.trans: “健康大使”的角色，薪水不如夜班清洁工。

examples.sentence: When rest is given only a supporting role, disease takes the lead without auditioning.
examples.trans: 若休息只被分配配角，疾病不用试镜就能领衔。

recovering.usageZh: 动词 recover 的 -ing，“恢复中”。recover from a cold；名词 recovery。

examples.sentence: He is recovering from a cold and staying home.
examples.trans: 他感冒正在恢复，待在家里。

examples.sentence: Recovering from PE means water and a sandwich, not another sprint.
examples.trans: 从体育课恢复意味着水和三明治，不是再冲刺。

examples.sentence: She spent the weekend recovering from a week that never named sleep.
examples.trans: 她用周末从从未点名睡眠的一周里恢复。

examples.sentence: A clinic recovering its hours after cuts still needs a bus that runs.
examples.trans: 削减后又恢复开放时间的诊所，仍需要一班还在跑的公交。

examples.sentence: Recovering a brand is cheaper than recovering a shoulder.
examples.trans: 恢复品牌比恢复肩膀便宜。

examples.sentence: A workforce always recovering from last night's rota is not resilient; it is unpaid repair.
examples.trans: 一支总在从昨夜排班里恢复的队伍，不是韧性，是无偿修理。

aids.usageZh: 动词 aid 的第三人称，“有助于”。aid in doing；名词 aid。勿与 AIDS 疾病缩写混淆（大小写/语境）。

examples.sentence: Water aids digestion after lunch.
examples.trans: 午饭后水有助于消化。

examples.sentence: A short walk aids her mood more than a speech.
examples.trans: 短走比演讲更有助于她的心情。

examples.sentence: Sleep aids memory; extra worksheets do not always.
examples.trans: 睡眠有助于记忆；额外的练习卷不总是如此。

examples.sentence: Soap aids the sink; the poster only aids the inspection photo.
examples.trans: 肥皂帮助水槽；海报只帮助检查照片。

examples.sentence: What aids a night nurse is a chair, not a motivational sticker.
examples.trans: 对夜班护士有帮助的是椅子，不是励志贴纸。

examples.sentence: Policy that aids shareholders first will still claim it aids immunity.
examples.trans: 先帮助股东的政策，仍会声称它帮助免疫。

hormones.usageZh: 名词 hormone 的复数，“激素”。stress hormones；形容词 hormonal。

examples.sentence: PE class can change your hormones and your mood together.
examples.trans: 体育课能同时改变你的激素和心情。

examples.sentence: Teen hormones are not an excuse to skip water.
examples.trans: 青春期激素不是不喝水的借口。

examples.sentence: Sleep sorts hormones; screens at midnight shuffle them.
examples.trans: 睡眠整理激素；午夜屏幕把它们打乱。

examples.sentence: Stress hormones clock in when the night rota does.
examples.trans: 压力激素在夜班排班打卡时一起打卡。

examples.sentence: Blaming hormones for a collapsed mood can hide a collapsed lunch break.
examples.trans: 把崩溃的心情怪在激素上，可能藏起崩溃的午休。

examples.sentence: A workplace that medicalises hormones and never minutes rest has chosen a convenient organ.
examples.trans: 把激素医学化、从不把休息写入会议记录的职场，选择了一个方便的器官。

viruses.usageZh: 名词 virus 的复数，“病毒”。fight/spread viruses。形容词 viral。

examples.sentence: Cover your mouth so viruses stay off the desk.
examples.trans: 捂住嘴，好让病毒离开桌子。

examples.sentence: Winter viruses travel faster than the soap refill.
examples.trans: 冬天的病毒比肥皂补给走得更快。

examples.sentence: Handwashing limits the transfer of viruses; a slogan does not.
examples.trans: 洗手限制病毒转移；口号不会。

examples.sentence: Lab viruses are labelled; canteen viruses wait on unwashed trays.
examples.trans: 实验室的病毒有标签；食堂的病毒等在未洗的托盘上。

examples.sentence: A viral wellness video rarely shows the sink behind it.
examples.trans: 走红的健康视频很少展示它背后的水槽。

examples.sentence: Public copy that fears viruses and not empty dispensers has chosen a photogenic enemy.
examples.trans: 害怕病毒却不怕空皂液器的公文，选择了一个上镜的敌人。

essential.usageZh: 形容词“必不可少的”。essential to/for；it is essential that。名词 essence。

examples.sentence: Water is essential after PE.
examples.trans: 体育课后水是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: Soap is essential; perfume is optional.
examples.trans: 肥皂是必要的；香水是可选的。

examples.sentence: Sleep is essential even when the worksheet disagrees.
examples.trans: 即使练习卷不同意，睡眠仍是必要的。

examples.sentence: A night bus is essential if the clinic is essential.
examples.trans: 若诊所是必要的，夜班车也是。

examples.sentence: Essential oils are not essential; running water is.
examples.trans: 精油不是必要的；自来水是。

examples.sentence: What a budget calls non-essential is often the towel that makes the guideline real.
examples.trans: 预算称为非必要的，常常是让准则变得真实的那条毛巾。

function.usageZh: 动词/名词“运转；功能”。function properly；the function of sleep。形容词 functional。

examples.sentence: Every part of your body needs water to function.
examples.trans: 身体每一部分都需要水才能运转。

examples.sentence: My brain does not function on three hours of sleep.
examples.trans: 我的脑子无法在三小时睡眠上运转。

examples.sentence: A sink that does not function turns a guideline into fiction.
examples.trans: 不运转的水槽把准则变成小说。

examples.sentence: The clinic functions until 5; viruses do not.
examples.trans: 诊所运转到五点；病毒不。

examples.sentence: Wellness copy functions as a mirror; policy should function as a tap.
examples.trans: 健康文案作为镜子运转；政策应当作为水龙头运转。

examples.sentence: A city can function on slogans only until the first unwashed outbreak writes the minutes.
examples.trans: 一座城市可以靠口号运转，直到第一场未洗手的暴发来写会议记录。

replace.usageZh: 及物动词“替换；补充”。replace A with B；replace lost water。名词 replacement。

examples.sentence: Replace the water you lose in PE.
examples.trans: 补上体育课流失的水。

examples.sentence: Do not replace sleep with another worksheet.
examples.trans: 不要用另一张练习卷替换睡眠。

examples.sentence: A vitamin ad cannot replace fruit that the canteen locked.
examples.trans: 维生素广告替换不了食堂锁起来的水果。

examples.sentence: They replaced the nurse with a poster of a nurse.
examples.trans: 他们用一张护士海报替换了护士。

examples.sentence: Replacing soap with scent is how inspections pass and hands fail.
examples.trans: 用香味替换肥皂，是检查通过、手失败的方式。

examples.sentence: A health system that replaces rest with resilience workshops has replaced the wrong noun.
examples.trans: 用韧性工作坊替换休息的卫生系统，替换错了名词。

germs.usageZh: 名词（常复数）“病菌”。wash germs away；spread germs。比 bacteria 口语。

examples.sentence: Wash germs off before lunch.
examples.trans: 午饭前把病菌洗掉。

examples.sentence: Germs love a door handle more than a textbook.
examples.trans: 病菌爱门把手胜过课本。

examples.sentence: You do not kill all germs; you wash them away.
examples.trans: 你杀不光病菌；你把它们洗走。

examples.sentence: Canteen germs wait on the tray nobody names in the inspection.
examples.trans: 食堂病菌等在检查从不点名的托盘上。

examples.sentence: A 'germ-free' ad still needs a sink that runs.
examples.trans: “无菌”广告仍需要能出水的水槽。

examples.sentence: Fear of germs that never funds towels is theatre with a white coat.
examples.trans: 从不给毛巾拨款的恐菌，是穿白大褂的戏剧。

transfer.usageZh: 动词/名词“转移；传播”。transfer germs from A to B；the transfer of viruses。

examples.sentence: Dirty hands transfer germs to bread.
examples.trans: 脏手把病菌转到面包上。

examples.sentence: Sneezing can transfer viruses across a desk.
examples.trans: 打喷嚏能把病毒转到对面桌子。

examples.sentence: Washing limits the transfer; a mask helps the rest.
examples.trans: 洗手限制传播；口罩帮忙其余部分。

examples.sentence: The canteen transfers trays faster than it transfers soap.
examples.trans: 食堂转移托盘比转移肥皂更快。

examples.sentence: A night shift transfers tiredness the way a sneeze transfers droplets.
examples.trans: 夜班转移疲倦，像喷嚏转移飞沫。

examples.sentence: Policy that tracks the transfer of slogans and not of paper towels has chosen its pathogen.
examples.trans: 追踪口号传播、不追踪擦手纸的政策，已经选好了它的病原体。

frequently.usageZh: 副词“频繁地”。wash frequently；more frequently than。形容词 frequent。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands frequently at school.
examples.trans: 在学校要勤洗手。

examples.sentence: He drinks water frequently during PE.
examples.trans: 体育课上他频繁喝水。

examples.sentence: The poster says frequently; the dispenser says sometimes.
examples.trans: 海报说频繁；皂液器说有时。

examples.sentence: Staff wash frequently when soap exists, not when cameras exist.
examples.trans: 有肥皂时员工才勤洗，不是有摄像头时。

examples.sentence: Illness visits more frequently where lunch breaks do not.
examples.trans: 午休不去的地方，病来得更勤。

examples.sentence: A guideline that uses frequently as a verb with no budget has adverb and no tap.
examples.trans: 把 frequently 当动词却无预算的准则，有副词没有水龙头。

properly.usageZh: 副词“正确地；适当地”。wash/function properly。形容词 proper。

examples.sentence: Wet your hands properly before soap.
examples.trans: 打肥皂前先把手充分打湿。

examples.sentence: If you do not dry properly, germs stay for the sandwich.
examples.trans: 擦不干，病菌就留给三明治。

examples.sentence: On average people do not wash properly; they rinse for a photograph.
examples.trans: 平均而言人们洗得不对；他们为拍照而冲一下。

examples.sentence: A clinic cannot function properly on a recording after 5.
examples.trans: 五点后靠录音，诊所无法正常运转。

examples.sentence: Sleeping properly is a skill the timetable keeps unlisting.
examples.trans: 睡得妥当是课表一直不列入的技能。

examples.sentence: Properly in a poster means twenty seconds; properly in a budget means the towel is still there.
examples.trans: 海报里的 properly 是二十秒；预算里的 properly 是毛巾还在。

prepare.usageZh: 动词“准备”。prepare food；prepare for a test。名词 preparation。

examples.sentence: Wash before you prepare a snack.
examples.trans: 准备点心前先洗手。

examples.sentence: She prepared fruit instead of a processed bar.
examples.trans: 她准备了水果，而不是加工棒。

examples.sentence: Prepare food with clean wrists, not only clean smiles.
examples.trans: 准备食物时手腕要干净，不只是微笑干净。

examples.sentence: The canteen prepares lunch; the inspection prepares a caption.
examples.trans: 食堂准备午餐；检查准备一句说明文字。

examples.sentence: Nobody prepared a chair for the night nurse.
examples.trans: 没有人为夜班护士准备椅子。

examples.sentence: A city that prepares slogans faster than soap has prepared the outbreak's first sentence.
examples.trans: 口号比肥皂准备得快的城市，已经为暴发准备好了第一句。

toilet.usageZh: 可数名词“厕所；马桶”。use the toilet；toilet paper。toilet 后洗手是课文重点。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands after the toilet.
examples.trans: 上厕所后要洗手。

examples.sentence: The school toilet had soap on Monday and a rumour on Tuesday.
examples.trans: 学校厕所周一有肥皂，周二只剩谣言。

examples.sentence: A toilet without running water is a guideline's blind spot.
examples.trans: 没有自来水的厕所是准则的盲点。

examples.sentence: Staff toilets tell you more about a canteen than the menu.
examples.trans: 员工厕所比菜单更能说明食堂。

examples.sentence: Luxury gyms photograph towels and hide the toilet queue.
examples.trans: 豪华健身房拍毛巾，藏厕所排队。

examples.sentence: Public health that cannot name a toilet will keep naming character.
examples.trans: 点不出厕所的公共卫生，会继续点名品格。

sneezing.usageZh: 动名词/现在分词“打喷嚏”。cover your mouth when sneezing。动词 sneeze。

examples.sentence: Cover your mouth when you are sneezing.
examples.trans: 打喷嚏时捂住嘴。

examples.sentence: Sneezing into your elbow beats sneezing into the bread.
examples.trans: 对着胳膊肘打喷嚏，好过对着面包。

examples.sentence: The class learned sneezing etiquette faster than it restocked tissues.
examples.trans: 班级学会打喷嚏礼仪，比补纸巾更快。

examples.sentence: A lab treats sneezing as data; a corridor treats it as weather.
examples.trans: 实验室把打喷嚏当数据；走廊把它当天气。

examples.sentence: Sneezing beside an empty dispenser is how posters become fiction.
examples.trans: 在空皂液器旁打喷嚏，是海报变成小说的方式。

examples.sentence: Policy that polices sneezing and not ventilation has chosen the cheaper droplet.
examples.trans: 管制打喷嚏却不管通风的政策，选择了更便宜的飞沫。

waste.usageZh: 名词“废物；排泄物”（不可数常见）。animal waste；waste of water。动词 waste。

examples.sentence: Wash after you touch animal waste at the farm.
examples.trans: 在农场碰过动物粪便后要洗手。

examples.sentence: Do not waste soap, but do not skip it either.
examples.trans: 不要浪费肥皂，但也不要跳过。

examples.sentence: Animal waste is a lesson; pretending it is 'just mud' is not.
examples.trans: 动物粪便是一课；假装它“只是泥”不是。

examples.sentence: Food waste in the canteen is also a hygiene story.
examples.trans: 食堂的食物浪费也是卫生故事。

examples.sentence: A waste of paper towels is cheaper than a waste of a term to flu.
examples.trans: 浪费擦手纸，比把一学期浪费给流感便宜。

examples.sentence: Calling rest a waste is how a rota writes disease into the average day.
examples.trans: 把休息叫做浪费，是排班把疾病写进平均一天的方式。

soap.usageZh: 名词“肥皂”（物质不可数；一块可数 a bar of soap）。wash with soap。

examples.sentence: Use soap, not only water.
examples.trans: 用肥皂，不只用水。

examples.sentence: The dispenser said soap and delivered air.
examples.trans: 皂液器写着肥皂，出来的是空气。

examples.sentence: Soap on the wrists and fingernails is the unphotogenic part.
examples.trans: 手腕和指甲上的肥皂是不上镜的部分。

examples.sentence: Canteen soap should outlast canteen slogans.
examples.trans: 食堂肥皂应当比食堂口号更耐久。

examples.sentence: A spa that scents soap and hides the tap has confused perfume with care.
examples.trans: 给肥皂加香却藏起水龙头的水疗，把香水和照料搞混了。

examples.sentence: Budgets that treat soap as optional have already chosen which hands may stay dirty.
examples.trans: 把肥皂当可选项的预算，已经选好了哪些手可以继续脏。

apply.usageZh: 动词“涂抹；应用”。apply soap to hands；apply a rule。名词 application。

examples.sentence: Apply soap to wet hands.
examples.trans: 把肥皂涂在湿手上。

examples.sentence: Apply the same rule after the toilet and before food.
examples.trans: 上厕所后和吃饭前用同一条规则。

examples.sentence: Apply pressure when you rub; a wave is not a wash.
examples.trans: 揉搓时要用力；挥一下手不是洗。

examples.sentence: The clinic applies gloves; the poster applies adjectives.
examples.trans: 诊所使用手套；海报使用形容词。

examples.sentence: Apply 'wellness' to a night rota and watch the word split.
examples.trans: 把“健康”涂到夜班排班上，看这个词裂开。

examples.sentence: A standard that applies to guests and not to staff is a costume, not a code.
examples.trans: 只适用于客人、不适用于员工的标准，是戏服，不是守则。

rub.usageZh: 动词“揉搓”。rub your hands together；rub soap in。名词 a rub。

examples.sentence: Rub your hands for at least twenty seconds.
examples.trans: 搓手至少二十秒。

examples.sentence: Rub the soap into your wrists, not only your palms.
examples.trans: 把肥皂搓进手腕，不只手心。

examples.sentence: On average we rub for six seconds and call it hygiene.
examples.trans: 平均我们搓六秒，并称之为卫生。

examples.sentence: Night cooks rub the same soap the inspection never smells.
examples.trans: 夜班厨师搓的是检查从未闻过的同一块肥皂。

examples.sentence: A campaign that counts rubs and not refills is counting theatre.
examples.trans: 数揉搓次数、不数补给的运动，是在数戏剧。

examples.sentence: What you refuse to rub — rest, soap, a name on a rota — is the real transfer.
examples.trans: 你拒绝揉搓的东西——休息、肥皂、排班上的名字——才是真正的传播。

wrists.usageZh: 名词 wrist 的复数，“手腕”。wash your wrists；wristband 是另一词。

examples.sentence: Don't forget your wrists when you wash.
examples.trans: 洗手时别忘了手腕。

examples.sentence: Soap on the wrists looks fussy until flu week.
examples.trans: 手腕上的肥皂在流感周之前看起来小题大做。

examples.sentence: Canteen work lives in the wrists as much as in the menu.
examples.trans: 食堂工作住在手腕里，和住在菜单里一样多。

examples.sentence: A lab coats the wrists; a poster coats the slogan.
examples.trans: 实验室给手腕穿上袖；海报给口号穿上袖。

examples.sentence: Jewellery on unwashed wrists is how a bracelet becomes a vehicle.
examples.trans: 未洗手腕上的首饰，是手镯变成载具的方式。

examples.sentence: Guidelines that name palms and not wrists have already abbreviated the body.
examples.trans: 点名手心、不点名手腕的准则，已经把身体缩写了。

fingernails.usageZh: 名词 fingernail 的复数，“指甲”。clean under fingernails。nail 也可。

examples.sentence: Dirt hides under fingernails after art class.
examples.trans: 美术课后污垢藏在指甲下。

examples.sentence: A nail brush is less glamorous than a vitamin, and more useful.
examples.trans: 指甲刷不如维生素风光，但更有用。

examples.sentence: Fingernails carry the farm's animal waste into the sandwich if you skip soap.
examples.trans: 若跳过肥皂，指甲会把农场粪便带进三明治。

examples.sentence: Inspectors check menus; cooks check fingernails.
examples.trans: 检查员查菜单；厨师查指甲。

examples.sentence: Polished fingernails on an empty-soap shift are a costume.
examples.trans: 空肥皂班次上的抛光指甲是戏服。

examples.sentence: A health aesthetic that photographs fingernails and never the brush has chosen shine over removal.
examples.trans: 只拍指甲不拍刷子的健康美学，选择了光泽而不是清除。

towel.usageZh: 可数名词“毛巾”。a clean towel；dry your hands on a towel。paper towel。

examples.sentence: Dry your hands on a clean towel.
examples.trans: 用干净毛巾擦干手。

examples.sentence: A wet towel in the bag grows its own biology lesson.
examples.trans: 包里的湿毛巾会自己长出一堂生物课。

examples.sentence: Paper towels ran out; the guideline did not.
examples.trans: 擦手纸用完了；准则没有。

examples.sentence: Sharing one towel in the clinic is how care becomes a vector.
examples.trans: 诊所共用一条毛巾，是照料变成传播媒介的方式。

examples.sentence: Spa towels are stacked; staff towels are a rumour.
examples.trans: 水疗毛巾码成堆；员工毛巾是谣言。

examples.sentence: A budget line that cuts towels has written the next outbreak in cotton.
examples.trans: 砍掉毛巾的预算行，已用棉花写下下一场暴发。

impossible.usageZh: 形容词“不可能的”。it is impossible to do；impossible for sb。名词 impossibility。

examples.sentence: It is impossible to stay clean without soap.
examples.trans: 没有肥皂就不可能保持干净。

examples.sentence: It is impossible to sleep nine hours and finish every extra sheet.
examples.trans: 睡九小时又做完每一张加练是不可能的。

examples.sentence: Although it is impossible to keep away from all germs, washing still limits them.
examples.trans: 虽然不可能远离所有病菌，洗手仍能限制它们。

examples.sentence: It is impossible for a recording to replace a night nurse.
examples.trans: 录音不可能替代夜班护士。

examples.sentence: Impossible in a poster often means 'we will not fund the obvious'.
examples.trans: 海报里的不可能，常常意味着“我们不会给显而易见的东西拨款”。

examples.sentence: A city that calls rest impossible has made a timetable sacred and a body optional.
examples.trans: 把休息称为不可能的城市，是把时刻表神圣化，把身体可选化。

limit.usageZh: 动词/名词“限制”。limit the transfer；a time limit。形容词 limited。

examples.sentence: Washing can limit germs on your sandwich.
examples.trans: 洗手能限制三明治上的病菌。

examples.sentence: Limit processed snacks to weekends if you can.
examples.trans: 若可以，把加工零食限制在周末。

examples.sentence: A twenty-second rub limits theatre more than a poster does.
examples.trans: 二十秒揉搓比海报更能限制演戏。

examples.sentence: Night hours limit the clinic; viruses do not read the sign.
examples.trans: 夜间时数限制诊所；病毒不读牌子。

examples.sentence: Limit 'resilience' as a noun until the rota has a chair.
examples.trans: 在排班有椅子之前，限制“韧性”这个名词。

examples.sentence: What you refuse to limit — extra classes, empty dispensers — is the real guideline.
examples.trans: 你拒绝限制的东西——加课、空皂液器——才是真正的准则。

average.usageZh: 形容词/名词“平均的；平均数”。on average；the average student。

examples.sentence: The average bottle in our class is empty by noon.
examples.trans: 我们班平均的水瓶到中午就空了。

examples.sentence: On average we sleep less in exam week.
examples.trans: 平均而言考试周我们睡得更少。

examples.sentence: The average wash lasts six seconds; the poster lasts a year.
examples.trans: 平均一次洗持续六秒；海报持续一年。

examples.sentence: Average canteen pay does not buy the fruit the menu photographs.
examples.trans: 食堂平均工资买不起菜单上拍的水果。

examples.sentence: An average of 'fine' on a survey can hide one night nurse on her feet.
examples.trans: 调查里平均的“还行”，能藏起一个一直站着的夜班护士。

examples.sentence: Public health that loves averages and fears names will keep missing the sink that failed.
examples.trans: 热爱平均数、害怕名字的公共卫生，会一直错过那只坏掉的水槽。

fight with.usageZh: 短语“与……斗争”。fight with a disease/problem。也可 fight against。注意 fight with sb 另有“和某人打架”。

examples.sentence: My immune system fights with winter colds.
examples.trans: 我的免疫系统在和冬天感冒斗争。

examples.sentence: She fought with flu and still sat the PE test.
examples.trans: 她和流感斗争，仍去考了体育。

examples.sentence: Sleep helps you fight with viruses better than a slogan.
examples.trans: 睡眠帮你对抗病毒，比口号强。

examples.sentence: Night staff fight with empty soap, not only with germs.
examples.trans: 夜班员工在和空肥皂斗争，不只和病菌。

examples.sentence: A brand that fights with 'negativity' may be fighting with a nurse's minutes.
examples.trans: 与“负面情绪”斗争的品牌，可能是在和护士的会议记录斗争。

examples.sentence: Public copy that fights with character and not with rotas has picked a safer opponent.
examples.trans: 和品格斗争、不和排班斗争的公文，挑了更安全的对手。

develop habits.usageZh: 短语“养成习惯”。develop good/healthy habits。habit 可数。

examples.sentence: We develop habits like washing before lunch.
examples.trans: 我们养成午饭前洗手这样的习惯。

examples.sentence: He developed the habit of carrying a bottle.
examples.trans: 他养成了带水瓶的习惯。

examples.sentence: You cannot develop sleep habits on a timetable that ends at midnight.
examples.trans: 在午夜才结束的课表上，养不成睡眠习惯。

examples.sentence: Canteen cooks developed habits the inspection never asked to see.
examples.trans: 食堂厨师养成的习惯，检查从未要求看见。

examples.sentence: Developing a 'gratitude habit' will not develop soap.
examples.trans: 养成“感恩习惯”不会养成肥皂。

examples.sentence: A city that develops wellness habits in posters and not in budgets has developed a font.
examples.trans: 在海报而非预算里养成健康习惯的城市，养成的是一种字体。

balanced diet.usageZh: 名词短语“均衡饮食”。have/follow a balanced diet。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet includes fruit, not only bread.
examples.trans: 均衡饮食包括水果，不只是面包。

examples.sentence: Her balanced diet still left room for Saturday cake.
examples.trans: 她的均衡饮食仍给周六蛋糕留了位置。

examples.sentence: A canteen balanced diet cannot live in a locked fruit fridge.
examples.trans: 食堂的均衡饮食无法活在上锁的水果冰箱里。

examples.sentence: Night workers need a balanced diet at 3 a.m., not a vending slogan.
examples.trans: 夜班工人凌晨三点需要均衡饮食，不是自动售货机口号。

examples.sentence: The label said balanced diet; the ingredients said sugar twice.
examples.trans: 标签写均衡饮食；配料表把糖写了两遍。

examples.sentence: A balanced diet photographed for a campaign is not the diet the cook can afford.
examples.trans: 为宣传拍下的均衡饮食，不是厨师买得起的饮食。

processed foods.usageZh: 名词短语（常复数）“加工食品”。avoid processed foods。

examples.sentence: Limit processed foods during the school week.
examples.trans: 上学周期间少吃加工食品。

examples.sentence: The vending machine is a museum of processed foods.
examples.trans: 自动售货机是加工食品博物馆。

examples.sentence: Processed foods outlast the apple that needed a fridge.
examples.trans: 加工食品比需要冰箱的苹果更耐久。

examples.sentence: Canteen tenders still list processed foods beside 'fresh' in the same breath.
examples.trans: 食堂招标仍把加工食品和“新鲜”放在同一口气里。

examples.sentence: Calling processed foods convenient hides who lost the kitchen hour.
examples.trans: 把加工食品叫做方便，藏起了谁失去了厨房的一小时。

examples.sentence: A food environment built on processed foods will keep selling immunity in a wrapper.
examples.trans: 建立在加工食品上的食物环境，会继续把免疫力卖在包装里。

take part in.usageZh: 短语“参加”。take part in exercise/a game。不可分开。

examples.sentence: I take part in PE even when it rains.
examples.trans: 下雨我也参加体育课。

examples.sentence: She took part in the morning run and then drank water.
examples.trans: 她参加了晨跑，然后喝了水。

examples.sentence: Taking part in regular exercise is a subject, not a poster.
examples.trans: 参加规律锻炼是主语，不是海报。

examples.sentence: Night cleaners take part in the gym's health without a membership.
examples.trans: 夜班清洁工参与了健身房的健康，却没有会员卡。

examples.sentence: Students take part in extra classes that take part in stealing sleep.
examples.trans: 学生参加加课，加课参加偷睡眠。

examples.sentence: A campaign that invites you to take part in wellness but not in the budget has invited an audience.
examples.trans: 请你参加健康、不请你参加预算的运动，请的是观众。

check with.usageZh: 短语“向……核实/咨询”。check with a doctor/teacher before doing。

examples.sentence: Check with Mum before you skip breakfast.
examples.trans: 不吃早饭前先问妈妈。

examples.sentence: Check with the nurse before a hard workout.
examples.trans: 高强度训练前先问护士。

examples.sentence: Check with the timetable before you promise nine hours of sleep.
examples.trans: 承诺九小时睡眠前，先问课表。

examples.sentence: Check with night staff before you print '24-hour care'.
examples.trans: 打印“全天候照料”前，先问夜班员工。

examples.sentence: Managers check with branding more often than with the sink.
examples.trans: 经理问品牌比问水槽更勤。

examples.sentence: A guideline that never says check with the people who refill soap has checked with a camera.
examples.trans: 从不说向补肥皂的人核实的准则，已经向摄像头核实过了。

pay attention to.usageZh: 短语“注意”。pay attention to your body/sleep。attention 不可数。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to water during PE.
examples.trans: 体育课注意喝水。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to your mood after late homework.
examples.trans: 晚作业之后注意你的心情。

examples.sentence: Pay more attention to soap than to the wellness app.
examples.trans: 多注意肥皂，少注意健康应用。

examples.sentence: Inspectors pay attention to menus; cooks pay attention to wrists.
examples.trans: 检查员注意菜单；厨师注意手腕。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to who is missing from the 'healthy staff' photo.
examples.trans: 注意“健康员工”照片里谁缺席。

examples.sentence: A state that pays attention to averages and not to names will keep missing the empty dispenser.
examples.trans: 注意平均数、不注意名字的国家，会一直错过空皂液器。

play a role in.usageZh: 短语“在……中起作用”。play an important role in (doing)。

examples.sentence: Sleep plays a role in memory.
examples.trans: 睡眠在记忆里起作用。

examples.sentence: Soap plays a role in every sandwich.
examples.trans: 肥皂在每一份三明治里起作用。

examples.sentence: Canteen cooks play a role in immunity that ads will not cast.
examples.trans: 食堂厨师在免疫里起广告不会选角的作用。

examples.sentence: Night buses play a role in clinic hours.
examples.trans: 夜班车在诊所开放时间里起作用。

examples.sentence: Slogans play a role in hiding the rota.
examples.trans: 口号在藏起排班方面起作用。

examples.sentence: Rest will play the lead if policy stops giving disease the only speaking part.
examples.trans: 若政策不再把唯一台词给疾病，休息就会领衔。

defend against.usageZh: 短语“抵御”。defend against viruses/cold。defend sb from 也可。

examples.sentence: Sleep helps you defend against colds.
examples.trans: 睡眠帮你抵御感冒。

examples.sentence: Soap defends against germs better than perfume.
examples.trans: 肥皂抵御病菌比香水强。

examples.sentence: You cannot defend against flu with a locked fruit fridge.
examples.trans: 锁着的水果冰箱抵御不了流感。

examples.sentence: A clinic defends against night viruses only if a bus defends the nurse.
examples.trans: 只有公交护着护士，诊所才能抵御夜间病毒。

examples.sentence: Branding defends against bad photos, not against empty soap.
examples.trans: 品牌抵御的是难看的照片，不是空肥皂。

examples.sentence: A budget that defends against 'waste' in towels has undefended the next outbreak.
examples.trans: 以防浪费为由砍毛巾的预算，已撤掉对下一场暴发的防御。

at hand.usageZh: 介词短语“在手边；可及”。keep water at hand。也表“即将到来”。

examples.sentence: Keep a bottle of water at hand.
examples.trans: 手边放一瓶水。

examples.sentence: Soap was not at hand, so we skipped the 'proper' wash.
examples.trans: 肥皂不在手边，于是我们跳过了“正确”的洗。

examples.sentence: Tissues at hand beat a speech about sneezing.
examples.trans: 手边的纸巾胜过关于打喷嚏的演讲。

examples.sentence: A nurse at hand after five is rarer than a recording at hand.
examples.trans: 五点后手边有护士，比手边有录音更稀有。

examples.sentence: Wellness apps are at hand; chairs for night staff are not.

examples.sentence: What is never at hand — soap, a bus, a name — is the real emergency.

wash your hands.usageZh: 动词短语“洗手”。祈使或陈述。wash one's hands of 是另一义“洗手不干”。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands before lunch.
examples.trans: 午饭前洗手。

examples.sentence: You should wash your hands after the toilet.
examples.trans: 上厕所后应当洗手。

examples.sentence: Wash your hands with soap, not only with hope.
examples.trans: 用肥皂洗手，不只用希望。

examples.sentence: Staff wash their hands in a sink the photo never includes.
examples.trans: 员工在照片从不收入的水槽里洗手。

examples.sentence: A campaign to wash your hands that will not fund towels has washed its hands of the sink.
examples.trans: 不给毛巾拨款的洗手运动，已对水槽洗手不干。

examples.sentence: Public health that says wash your hands and then cuts water has issued a riddle.
examples.trans: 一边说洗手一边停水的公共卫生，出的是谜语。

keep away from.usageZh: 短语“远离”。keep away from germs/danger。keep sb away from。

examples.sentence: Keep away from a sneezing classmate's desk.
examples.trans: 远离正在打喷嚏的同学的桌子。

examples.sentence: Keep away from processed snacks if fruit is actually there.
examples.trans: 如果水果真的在，就远离加工零食。

examples.sentence: Although you cannot keep away from all germs, you can limit them.
examples.trans: 虽然不能远离所有病菌，但能限制它们。

examples.sentence: Keep away from a clinic that is only a recording.
examples.trans: 远离只有录音的诊所。

examples.sentence: Keep away from 'immune' drinks that keep you away from sleep.
examples.trans: 远离让你远离睡眠的“免疫”饮料。

examples.sentence: A policy that tells bodies to keep away from germs and cities to keep away from taps has chosen a sermon.

wash away.usageZh: 短语动词“洗掉”。wash germs/soap away。可分开 wash them away。

examples.sentence: Slogans try to wash away a rota; soap cannot.

examples.sentence: A clinic that cannot offer tissues still prints 'blow your nose'.
examples.trans: 不能提供纸巾的诊所仍打印“请擤鼻涕”。

examples.sentence: Wash after you touch animal waste.
examples.trans: 碰过动物粪便后要洗手。

examples.sentence: The farm visit made animal waste a real noun, not a cartoon.
examples.trans: 农场参观让动物粪便变成真名词，不是卡通。

examples.sentence: Animal waste under fingernails is how a picnic becomes a lab.

examples.sentence: Guidelines name animal waste; they should name the tap beside the barn.

examples.trans: 把街上的动物粪便当作品格问题的城市，跳过了垃圾桶。

examples.trans: 若海报点名肥皂，预算至少也要点名。

examples.sentence: Night staff need at least a chair, not at least a sticker.
examples.trans: 夜班员工至少需要一把椅子，不是至少一张贴纸。

examples.trans: 至少调查是诚实的：平均一次洗是六秒。

grammar.title: not only...but also... 与倒装、主谓一致、both/as well as
grammar.usage:
not only... but also... 连接并列成分，强调后者。A healthy body not only helps you live more actively, but it can also allow you to live longer.

拓展：
- Not only 置于句首时部分倒装：Not only does sleep help mood, but it also defends against viruses.
- 连接两个主语时，谓语与 but also 后的主语一致：Not only the posters but also the soap is missing.
- both...and... 两者并重，不倒装。
- as well as 谓语常随前面主语。
- not only A but B（省略 also）书面常见。
不要 although...but 或 not only...but also 与 because 叠床架屋。
forms: Not only + 助动词 + 主语
靠近原则：动词随 but also 后主语
notes: 句首 not only 要倒装。
两个主语看 but also 后。

examples.en: Water not only helps you run, but it also helps you think.
examples.cn: 水不仅帮你跑步，也帮你思考。

examples.en: A walk not only clears the head, but it also steadies mood.
examples.cn: 走路不仅清头脑，也稳心情。

examples.en: Not only do six-second rinses fail, they photograph well.
examples.cn: 六秒冲洗不仅失败，还特别上镜。

examples.en: Not only does the recording mention spa hours, it replaces a clinic.
examples.cn: 录音不仅提到水疗时间，它还替代了诊所。

examples.en: Not only does occupancy count as joy, it counts as a hymn.
examples.cn: 满员不仅被算成快乐，还被唱成赞美诗。

examples.en: Not only do averages hide the failed tap, they flatter the font.
examples.cn: 平均数不仅藏起坏掉的龙头，还恭维了字体。

grammar.title: 动名词作主语：习惯、卫生与 It is...to do 转换
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as subject; it is adj to do; to-infinitive subject
grammar.usage:
动名词作主语：Taking part in regular exercise is important. 谓语用单数。

拓展：
- It is + adj. + (for sb) + to do 与 Doing is adj. 转换。
- To do 作主语更正式：To wash properly takes twenty seconds.
- There's no use / no point in doing。
- 复合：Washing your hands after the toilet keeps sandwiches safer.
否定：Not sleeping enough ruins mood.
forms: There is no point/use in doing
复合动名词短语仍单数
notes: It is important to wash = Washing is important。

grammar.title: 情态 can / could / be able to / may / might：能力、可能、许可（健康场景）
grammar.titleEn: can, could, be able to, may, might for health
grammar.usage:

拓展：could 过去/委婉；be able to 各时态；may/might 可能；must 推测。否定 cannot。将来 will be able to，不用 will can。一次成功常用 was able to。

examples.en: She can swim after she drinks water.
examples.cn: 她喝过水就能游。

examples.en: A vitamin cannot replace fruit.

examples.en: A recording cannot be an emergency line.
examples.cn: 录音不可能是急救热线。

examples.en: A wrapper cannot be an immune system.

examples.en: A font cannot wash an outbreak away.

cannot 能写成 can't。

exercises.answer: The empty dispenser must have been a choice.

grammar.title: 祈使句：健康建议与禁止（Don't / Let's / Always）
grammar.titleEn: Imperatives for health advice: Don't, Let's, Always
grammar.usage:
祈使句以动词原形开头，省略 you，用于命令、请求、建议。Keep a bottle of water at hand.

拓展：Don't / Never + 原形；Let's / Let's not；Always/Never 句首；Do + 原形强调；Please 可前可后；祈使 + and/or + will。
主语一般不出现；强调时可用 You sit down。否定不是 Doesn't wash。
notes: 否定 Don't 不是 Doesn't。

examples.en: Keep a bottle of water at hand.
examples.cn: 手边放一瓶水。

examples.cn: 冲刺前先问护士。

examples.cn: 别把包装纸叫做免疫系统。

examples.en: Name the failed sink, not only the average.
